author: hollowstrawberry
Sablinova
description: Sends modified links to embed content from popular social media sites: Twitter/X, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, Pixiv, Threads, and more with per-channel toggles.
install_msg:
LinkFixer installed.
Instructions:
1. Load it with [p]load linkfixer
2. Enable server-wide with [p]linkfixer enable, or per channel with [p]linkfixer channel enable #channel
3. Links from twitter, tiktok, instagram, etc. will automatically embed properly.
short: Sends modified links to embed content from popular social media sites with per-channel toggles.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data.
